issuesEn: No exported duration, so the workbench took the card's "typing ~40f" and rendered 40 frames: the clip stops mid-typing and never shows the hard-cut materialize, the shrink or the reveal
Both backgrounds are flat solid fills (#fcfcfb / #f4f1e5), large dead light planes
The pill is a flat grey rounded rectangle with no light or ground contact; its "object" feel rests on size alone
The 0.55x shrink peaks near 70px/frame yet stays razor sharp, reading as a sliding sticker; the final page has only title, pill and body with no page chrome
changesEn: Exported HASHTAG_TO_PILL_MATERIALIZE_DURATION = 120 (~1.2s of stillness after the reveal at 83f); the 48/66/80/83 beats and both 1-frame hard cuts are unchanged
Backgrounds are faint vertical paper gradients with 0.05 grain, still hard-cut on the reveal frame

The pill stays strokeless but gains a top-lit micro volume, a 3px inner top highlight and a two-layer soft shadow: lifted 10px as the hero, descending through the second half of the shrink and lying flat in its slot
The shrink uses SpeedBlur for velocity-driven directional blur (0.1× speed, capped at 7px), zero at both ends
The final page gains a 32px low-contrast header (Notes / Music · Edited just now) with a fading hairline rule for a complete layout
